CriticalHooks

class CriticalHooks[source]

Bases: object

Encapsulate global exception hooks for the application.

This class registers handlers for uncaught exceptions in the main thread and worker threads, and displays a translated error dialog when Qt is available.

Methods

show_critical_error(exception)

Display a translated critical error dialog for an exception.

global_exception_hook(exctype, value, traceback_obj)

Handle uncaught exceptions on the main thread.

threading_exception_hook(args)

Handle uncaught exceptions in worker threads.

setup_exception_hooks()

Register global exception hooks for the application.

Notes

The dialog text is translated at runtime with QCoreApplication.translate in the "CriticalHooks" context.

static show_critical_error(exception)[source]

Show a translated critical error dialog.

Parameters:
exceptionBaseException

The exception that caused the failure; its text is appended to the message.

Notes

The message (pt_BR source text) is translated at runtime with QCoreApplication.translate in the "CriticalHooks" context and shown with MessageService.critical_global. If the dialog cannot be displayed (e.g. Qt is not ready yet), the error is printed to standard output instead.

static global_exception_hook(exctype, value, traceback_obj)[source]

Handle uncaught exceptions on the main thread.

Installed as sys.excepthook.

Parameters:
exctypetype[BaseException]

The exception class.

valueBaseException

The exception instance.

traceback_objTracebackType | None

The traceback object, if available.

Notes

The exception is written to the application log with its stack trace. The dialog is shown only if a QApplication instance exists; otherwise a message is printed. The default sys.__excepthook__ then prints the traceback and the application exits with status 1.

static threading_exception_hook(args)[source]

Handle uncaught exceptions in worker threads.

Installed as threading.excepthook.

Parameters:
argsthreading.ExceptHookArgs

Thread exception hook arguments.

Notes

This hook only logs the exception with its stack trace. It shows no dialog, to avoid thread safety issues with Qt widgets, and does not end the application.

static setup_exception_hooks()[source]

Register the global exception hooks for the application.

Sets sys.excepthook to global_exception_hook and threading.excepthook to threading_exception_hook.
